image_query: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple gold vimana gopuram
tweets: High atop the Veṅkaṭādri hill — where legend holds earth meets Vaikuṇṭha — rises Śrī Veṅkateśvara's shrine. Its sanctum crown, the Ānanda Nilayam vimāna, was sheathed in gold under Vijayanagara's Kṛṣṇadevarāya in 1518 CE, and still catches the first Deccan light.
